issues.issue: Whether the ALJR was filed within the statutory 15-day limit
issues.applicant_position: Applicants say they became aware of the decision on the filing date, 37 days after it was mailed.
issues.respondent_position: Application is time-barred under IRPA s. 72(2)(b) and (d); respondent moved to strike it.
issues.result_text: Court concludes without doubt the application is statute-barred; applicants did not seek an extension.

issues.issue: Whether the application can be summarily dismissed on a preliminary motion
issues.respondent_position: Respondent moved to strike the ALJR as time-barred on a preliminary motion.
issues.result_text: Given the uncontested delay and exceptional nature, summary dismissal of the ALJR was ordered.
